facts.title: Greek Kale Salad with Creamy Tahini Dressing
ingredients: 1 medium bunch of curly green kale (about 8 ounces)
1 can (15 ounces) chickpeas, rinsed and drained, or 1 ½ cups cooked chickpeas
½ cup thinly sliced Kalamata olives and/or roughly chopped pepper rings
⅓ cup oil-packed sun-dried tomatoes, rinsed and drained
3 tablespoons lemon juice (from 1 to 1 ½ lemons)
1 medium clove garlic, pressed or minced
Freshly ground black pepper, to taste
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
